beaches.name: Kolitsani
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is usual on the eastern part of the cove, before the dividing rock. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2005 to 2022; informal 'nude beach' signs are reported on the access paths, and a 2023 Greek press listicle names Kolitsani. The western part fills with clothed bathers, and nudists thin out on busy afternoons.

beaches.name: Tris Klissies
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed visitors mix at this remote beach west of Manganari. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2002 to 2024 describing a handful of people, mostly nude, with the 2024 visitors alone all day. Access is a marked footpath from the Manganari road; no facilities or signage are documented.
